observability_triage.rationale: The at-most-three-pages clause is objective, but page count after legacy-content paste is a Word layout-engine result. The frozen repository contains neither the named legacy DOCX fixtures nor a pinned Word renderer/automation surface that can perform the paste and report rendered pagination. The qualitative phrase 'spacing be reduced' is not independently testable without a numeric spacing contract.
